description: Get a secure Stripe checkout link for the signed-in member, for one of two things. for: "wallet" loads their wallet with $5, $10, $25 (amount_dollars). for: "plan" buys the Manage or Autopilot plan (plan) at their account type's monthly price; say that price, from the result, when giving the link. NOTHING IS CHARGED BY THIS TOOL: they pay on Stripe's page, and the balance or plan updates a few seconds after. Give the link exactly as returned. Never ask for or accept card details in the conversation. Only set auto_reload when the member has clearly asked for automatic reloads; it lets ShearQuery charge the same card the same amount when the balance runs low, at most once a day. A member who ALREADY has a paid plan is not switched; the result gives the page where switching and cancelling are done.

amount_dollars.description: For the wallet: how much to load, in dollars.

auto_reload.description: For the wallet: true ONLY if the member asked for automatic reloads. Defaults to false.

plan.description: For a plan: the one they chose.

name: checkout_link
title: A Stripe link to load the wallet or buy a plan
